description_en: You can call the DescribeContainerGroupMetric operation to query the monitoring data of an ECI instance
description_zh: 调用DescribeContainerGroupMetric查询一个ECI实例的监控数据
kebab_example: aliyun eci describe-multi-container-group-metric --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --container-group-ids eci-2zegym1qhbmdfr1s0000_,_eci-2ze39w5svzj5ic340000 --resource-group-id rg-acfmzw2jz2z0000 --metric-type summary --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeMultiContainerGroupMetric

parameters.description_en: The IDs of the ECI instances. The value is the same as the container group ID. Specify the IDs in a JSON array. You can specify a maximum of 20 IDs.
parameters.description_zh: ECI实例ID，即容器组ID。格式为JSON数组，一次最多支持20个ID。
